newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen says FTC seeks data on 27 states.
newsitem.headline: Loewen says FTC seeks data on 27 states.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission has asked the Loewen Group Inc for more information in connection with an inquiry into Service Corp International's US$2.9 billion hostile bid for Loewen.

Loewen said Friday that the FTC's second request for information seeks details on its business in over 100 markets in 27 states including "breakdowns with respect to certain ethnic markets." Service earlier announced the FTC had asked for more information.
Loewen, the second biggest operator of funeral homes and cemeteries in North America, has rejected the bid by Service, its bigger rival.

Loewen has sought to highlight potential anti-trust obstacles to the deal. Houston-based Service has said it believes any anti-trust concerns can be overcome by disposing of a limited number of properties.
Loewen previously announced that nine U.S. states, the FTC and Canada's competition bureau were probing the offer.
It said the FTC's second request for information also covers Loewen's Prime Succession Inc unit and Equity Corp. International which is 40-percent owned by Service.
